gloss: here and there; all over the place; various places

definitions.gloss: here and there; all over the place; various places
definitions.explanation: Multiple scattered locations; used to describe something occurring or existing in many different places.

examples.japanese: あちらこちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧であちらこちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}する→出張する：26986_shucchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I travel here and there on business trips for work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、あちらこちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傷|きず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ようになってきた。
examples.english: Since it's an old building, damage has become noticeable here and there.

notes:
Formed by combining ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧ (over there) and ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧ (over here). Describes scattered or widespread distribution across multiple locations. The more casual equivalent is ⟦あっちこっち→あっちこっち：30344_acchikocchi⟧, which is common in everyday speech. Both expressions can function as nouns or adverbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あちらこちら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in various places
- あちらこちら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at various places
- あちらこちら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go around various places
- あちらこちら⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from various places

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あっちこっち→あっちこっち：30344_acchikocchi⟧: here and there — casual form of あちらこちら, more common in spoken language
- ⟦{方々|ほうぼう}→方々：00116_houbou⟧: all around; everywhere — slightly more formal, emphasizes searching or moving around
- ⟦{至|いた}る{所|ところ}→至る所：15861_itarutokoro⟧: everywhere; all over — stronger emphasis on ubiquity
